title: Security Architect
summary: A security architect designs the security controls for a company's systems, networks and cloud before they are built. It is a senior role that sets security standards and reviews designs, working with engineering, risk and business teams.
dailyDuties: Define security reference architectures and zero trust designs
Threat-model new systems and major changes
Set identity, privileged access and MFA standards
Design network segmentation, firewall and VPN controls
Choose encryption, PKI and key management approaches
Map designs to ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS or RBI requirements and document risks
Write security standards and present design reviews to senior leaders

skills.expectation: Define security reference architectures, patterns and zero trust designs
Threat model new systems and major changes
Set identity, privileged access and MFA standards
Design segmentation, firewall and VPN controls
Secure designs on AWS, Azure or GCP
Choose encryption, PKI and key management approaches
Review application designs against common attack patterns
Map designs to ISO 27001, NIST, PCI DSS or RBI requirements
Assess and document design risks and exceptions
Agree controls with engineering, risk and business teams
Write security standards and present reviews to senior leaders
Turn architecture into policies and baseline standards
Build security checks into delivery pipelines
Use posture tools to track cloud misconfigurations
Design for DPDP Act and other privacy duties

certifications.why: The certificate most Indian security architect listings ask for
Some Indian security architect postings ask for Azure architecture depth.
